video_title: Will LeBron team up with Steph Curry in Golden State? 😳 Breaking down the latest reports | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James faces a critical decision regarding his Lakers future
quotes.excerpt: the consequence for him not making up his mind is increasing the chance of the Lakers moving on

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It is June 29th. The new league year is hours away. LeBron has $52 million cap hold on the books. The decisions have to get made. If he is not ready to make up his mind, he does not have to make up his mind, but the consequence for him not making up his mind is increasing the chance of the Lakers moving on. I think LeBron fully understands that. He certainly understands the timeline.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Eventually, you know that LeBron was going to leave, if not now, at some point in the near future.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' original plan was to build the team around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: the original plan was to build the team around Luka Doncic
quotes.quote: I wrote a story last year about when JJ Redick and Rob Pelinka took Luka Doncic and his manager, Laura Besker, to lunch at Craig's in Melrose. They laid out their plans and that was to convince Luka Doncic to sign that extension that he ended up signing with them. But in those plans, those plans did not include LeBron James. They had the salary cap space starting this summer. LeBron played incredible last season. He has been an asset to this team. He was willing to take a third role. I think the Lakers would love to have him back, but he has not given them an answer. And the original plan was to build the team around Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Top free agents are restricted, complicating the Lakers' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: the top free agents are restricted. Jalen Duren and Walker Kessler at center
quotes.quote: Cap space is great for me to talk about, but it is fool's gold when it comes to teams because you are going into a free agent market that is below average. The top free agents are restricted. Jalen Duren and Walker Kessler at center. They need three things: a center, they need shooting, and they need an athletic wing. And an athletic wing is Peyton Watson also, who is also restricted free agent here. So you are trying to balance out how to fill in the gaps because if you offer one of these players an offer sheet, all these other free agents are going to be off the board by the time these teams match here.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James may be ready to move on from the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I am not sure that they want to trade Jimmy Butler. And if getting LeBron is predicated on getting Anthony Davis
quotes.quote: I am not sure that they want to trade Jimmy Butler. And if getting LeBron is predicated on getting Anthony Davis, I am not sure this is going to be happening. I think Anthony Davis would be great, but I think LeBron may be ready to go. And by the way, getting LeBron at $15 million at this point in his career would be potentially a tremendous sign.
